body:
## Reproduction
In the actual angled game at 1920×1080, create a prison, move the pointer onto the map once, then use only keyboard focus/Enter to open Build → Room plans, select a card, mirror it and choose Place on map. The world ghost stays hidden until the mouse physically moves. Escape followed by keyboard-only rearming has the same gap.

The native dialog button coordinates do not become the world origin. The actual failure is that the bridge discards the genuine map hover when the tool is unarmed.

## Evidence and repair
Production-artifact baseline browser failed because the first Basic cell ghost remained hidden for 10 s (16.3 s case). The focused unit regression also failed before the fix. Checkpoint 0d18c5a7a3 preserves only canvas hover across keyboard selection/rearming and invalidates it after actual pointer movement over UI; UI coordinates are never picked.

Focused bridge/fit tests: 14 passed. Removing the remembered-hover fallback makes the added regression fail. Restored production browser verifies all 20 plans in two single-worker Full HD cases: keyboard selection, actual mirrored preflight target, genuine worker quote, visible footprint, Escape, restored focus and zero placement commands; 2 passed in 52.5 s. No timeout or retry increase.

Related #1914 concerns camera-turn reprojection of an already visible ghost and is a distinct cause.
title: Keyboard-only room-plan selection and rearming loses the unchanged map hover
